halomcc-your-journey-begins-467ebc6bb3.description: Uzuza ubutumwa bwo kwiyamamaza cyangwa guhuza abantu benshi.
halomcc-your-journey-begins-467ebc6bb3.guideDescription: Gufungura ibyagezweho "Your Journey Begins" muri Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), ugomba gusa kurangiza neza ubutumwa ubwo aribwo bwose bwo kwiyamamaza cyangwa umukino wa benshi.

halomcc-just-getting-started-24ea4c9ab6.guideDescription: Gufungura ibyagezweho "Just Getting Started" muri Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), ugomba gusa kwica abanzi 100 cyangwa abakinnyi 100 mubutumwa ubwo aribwo bwose bwo kwiyamamaza cyangwa umukino wa benshi.

halomcc-i-m-sorry-dave-c5354b9fe4.description: Halo: Reach: Shakisha umukono wa binary.
halomcc-i-m-sorry-dave-c5354b9fe4.guideDescription:
Gufungura ibyagezweho "I’m Sorry, Dave" muri Halo: Reach muri Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), ugomba kumenya amagi yihariye ya pasika yunamira David Candland, umuyobozi wumukino UI. Dore inzira irambuye yuburyo bwo kuyibona:

1. Tangira ubutumwa ubwo aribwo bwose bwo kwiyamamaza cyangwa ikarita ya benshi muri Halo: Reach.
2. Tora intwaro ** idafite ** ifite imiterere yo gukuza. Ingero zisanzwe zirimo imbunda ya Assault cyangwa Pistolet Plasma.
3. Kanda buto ya zoom (mubisanzwe inkoni iburyo kuri kanseri cyangwa urufunguzo rwabigenewe kuri PC) kuri "zoom in" n'intwaro yawe idakingiye.
4. Reba neza kuri ** hepfo ibumoso ** ya ecran yawe. Uzabona umurongo wa binary code igaragara muri make.
5. Iyi code ya binary isobanura ijambo "Dave" muburyo bwa ASCII.

Ukurikije izi ntambwe ukareba kode ya binary, uzafungura ibyagezweho "I’m Sorry, Dave".

halomcc-balaho-s-most-wanted-03c5a591ce.guideDescription: Gufungura ibyagezweho "Balaho’s Most Wanted" muri Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), uzakenera kuvanaho hamwe 100 Grunts zose hamwe muburyo bwa PVE, zirimo ubukangurambaga, kuzimya umuriro, na Spartan Ops. Kubwamahirwe, ibyagezweho birashobora gufungurwa byoroshye mugukina bisanzwe.

halomcc-the-one-percent-088630ade1.guideDescription: Gufungura ibyagezweho "The One Percent" muri Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), uzakenera kuvanaho intore zose hamwe 100 muburyo bwa PVE, zirimo ubukangurambaga, kuzimya umuriro, na Spartan Ops. Kubwamahirwe, ibyagezweho birashobora gufungurwa byoroshye mugukina bisanzwe.

halomcc-we-re-just-getting-started-4fd09.guideDescription: Kugira ngo ufungure ibyagezweho "We're Just Getting Started" muri Halo: Reach muri Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), ugomba gusa gukina binyuze mu butumwa "Winter Contingency" kuva mu ntangiriro kugeza ku iherezo ku ngorane iyo ari yo yose.

halomcc-just-a-taste-9a52606cd4.description: Kusanya imidari 500 yo kwiyamamaza cyangwa gukina urutonde.

halomcc-stick-with-it-a-little-longer-17.description: Kina umukino wabantu benshi cyangwa koperative byibuze amezi 3 nyuma yumukino wawe wambere.
halomcc-stick-with-it-a-little-longer-17.guideDescription:
Gufungura ibyagezweho "Stick With It...A Little Longer" muri Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), ugomba gusa gukina umukino wabantu benshi cyangwa koperative byibuze amezi 3 nyuma yo gukina umukino wawe wambere.

Bitandukanye nibindi byagezweho, iyi ntishobora gufungurwa mugukoresha itariki ya sisitemu, nkuko bigenzurwa na seriveri.

halomcc-pillar-of-autumn-ca48de1ce8.guideDescription: Gufungura ibyagezweho "Pillar of Autumn" muri Halo: CE muri Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), ugomba gusa gukina binyuze mubutumwa bwa "Pillar of Autumn" kuva mu ntangiriro kugeza ku iherezo kubibazo byose.

halomcc-the-guardians-are-coming-f21d333.guideDescription:
Ibyagezweho "The Guardians Are Coming" muri Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC) birashobora gufungurwa muguhura nibintu bidasanzwe: kwicwa muburyo butesha moteri yimikino. Iyo ibi bibaye, umukino mubisanzwe werekana ubutumwa, "You were killed by The Guardians." Dore uburyo butaziguye bwo kubona ibyo wagezeho:

1. Kuri menu nkuru ya Halo MCC, hitamo kwiyamamaza Halo 2.
2. Jya mu guhitamo ubutumwa.
3. Shiraho igihanga cya scarab nkigikorwa.
4. Fata ubutumwa bwa mbere cyangwa ubundi butumwa bwose ukunda.
5. Kina kugeza ubonye intwaro.
6. Kurasa hasi.
7. Ibyagezweho byafunguwe!

Niba ukurikije izi ntambwe, uzagira "The Guardians Are Coming" mucyegeranyo cyawe.

halomcc-i-need-a-weapon-0305f283a3.guideDescription: Kugira ngo ufungure ibyagezweho "I Need A Weapon" muri Halo: Reach muri Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), ugomba gusa gukina binyuze mu butumwa "Nightfall" kuva mu ntangiriro kugeza ku iherezo ku ngorane iyo ari yo yose.

halomcc-bite-the-hand-cc4675d512.description: Kwica 343 uteza imbere muguhuza cyangwa umuntu ufite ibyo yagezeho.
halomcc-bite-the-hand-cc4675d512.guideDescription: Gufungura "Bite The Hand" muri Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), umurongo wo guhuza abantu benshi no kwica abo muhanganye mugihe gisanzwe. Intego irashobora kuba umuterimbere cyangwa umukinnyi uwo ari we wese usanzwe ufite ibyo yagezeho, komeza rero ukine kugeza ubonye ubwicanyi bujuje ibisabwa. Video irerekana umwimerere Halo 4 verisiyo yagezweho, ikoresha imbarutso imwe yo guhuza.

halomcc-mind-the-skill-gap-566b495f16.guideDescription: Gufungura "Mind the Skill Gap" muri Halo: Reach muri Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kuri Tip of Icumu, reba ikirango cya BXR Mining ku bucukuzi bw'amabuye y'agaciro. Hagarara aho ufite ibitekerezo bisobanutse kandi urebe neza ku kimenyetso cyisosiyete kugirango utere ibyagezweho.

halomcc-going-bananas-a3478a4999.guideDescription: Gufungura "Going Bananas" muri Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kura Brute 100. Ongera uhure Halo 3 cyangwa Halo 3: ODST uranga uyu mwanzi. Komeza gukuraho abanzi bujuje ibisabwa nkuko ukora mubindi bikorwa.

halomcc-you-flew-pretty-good-ef665babe8.guideDescription: Kugira ngo ufungure ibyagezweho "You Flew Pretty Good" muri Halo: Reach muri Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), ugomba gusa gukina binyuze mu butumwa "Long Night of Solace" kuva mu ntangiriro kugeza ku iherezo ku ngorane iyo ari yo yose.

halomcc-front-page-news-951f11d7eb.guideDescription: Gufungura "Front Page News" muri Halo: Reach muri Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), munsange muri club. Koresha videwo kugirango umenye ibimenyetso byerekana inzira. Niba ari ikintu, nimwimuke hafi kugirango musabane nayo mbere yo gukomeza mukarere.

halomcc-dust-and-echoes-abf0cf7266.guideDescription: Gufungura "Dust And Echoes" muri Halo: Reach muri Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), fata Alegizandiriya Nshya kuva ugitangira ingorane iyo ari yo yose hanyuma ukine kugeza ku ntego yanyuma. Kurikiza ibimenyetso byubutumwa hanyuma urangize urwego kugirango ibisobanutse byanditswe muri Guhitamo Inshingano.

halomcc-the-silent-cartographer-463f102f.guideDescription: Gufungura "The Silent Cartographer" muri Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary muri Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), fata Cartografi Yicecekeye kuva mugitangira ingorane iyo ari yo yose hanyuma ukine kugeza kumugambi wanyuma. Shikira sitasiyo yumutekano ubanze ufungure ikigo, hanyuma umanuke kuri Cartographe.

halomcc-easy-to-overlook-7e6f804af3.description: Halo: Reach: Kugera kuri radio UNSC ihishe.
halomcc-easy-to-overlook-7e6f804af3.guideDescription: Gufungura "Easy to Overlook" muri Halo: Reach muri Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), shaka ibiganiro byihishe kuri radio UNSC. Tangirira kumwanya werekanwe muri videwo hanyuma ukurikire imiterere yabyo mbere yo kugerageza igikorwa.

halomcc-your-heresy-will-stay-your-feet-.description: Halo: Reach: Kwica Elite Zelote mbere yuko ahunga mugihe cy'inama y'icumu.
halomcc-your-heresy-will-stay-your-feet-.guideDescription: Gufungura "Your Heresy Will Stay Your Feet" muri Halo: Reach muri Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), bica Elite Zelote mbere yuko ahunga mugihe cy'inama y'icumu. Koresha intwaro imwe, ibinyabiziga, cyangwa umwanya werekanye kuri videwo. Niba intego isaba ikintu cyanyuma, reka guhagarika ibindi byangiritse iyo intego iba ifite intege nke.

halomcc-the-chips-dubbo-46489745e0.description: Halo 2: Kurwana kuruhande rwa Chips Dubbo wamugani wumve amagambo ye.
halomcc-the-chips-dubbo-46489745e0.guideDescription: Gufungura "THE Chips Dubbo?" muri Halo 2: Anniversary muri Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kina Outskirts kandi ugume hafi ya Marine mugihe urwana no guhura. Komeza Marine uvuga Australiya kandi ube hafi kugeza wunvise Chips Dubbo avuga. Niba apfuye mbere yuko umwumva, ongera utangire kuri bariyeri.
